source.citation: K. Karahashi, Surface Science Society of Japan 28, 60-65 (2007); open review of the mass-selected beam experiments reported in JVST A 22, 1166 (2004), DOI 10.1116/1.1761119

experiment_scope.quantity: etched SiO2 units per incident ion

digitization.method: 600-dpi Poppler render; PIL dark-pixel axis localization; marker-center and plotted-cap transcription; connected-contour and full-resolution visual-overlay reconciliation
digitization.nominal_energy_policy: use plotted experimental setpoints; retain marker x pixels only as an independent placement check
digitization.uncertainty_basis: 3.5-pixel vertical center-placement allowance, rounded upward after the linear y-axis transform
digitization.plotted_bounds_policy: transcribe the source error-bar caps but do not call them a confidence interval because the accessible source text does not define their statistical meaning

claim_boundary.valid: direct radical-free single-species beam benchmark over the digitized species/energy support
not_valid: an ion-mixture law for the Krueger reactor
